meta.title: Beach Girl Property Rentals — Old Orchard Beach, ME
meta.description: Owner-managed vacation rentals in Old Orchard Beach, Maine. Cottages and apartments steps from the sand. No hidden booking fees — just a quick message to Jill.

hero.desc: Owner-managed rentals near the beach in Old Orchard Beach. Skip the Airbnb and Vrbo fees — message Jill directly and you're one step closer to having your toes in the sand.

owner.title: I'm Jill.
owner.p1: I've been welcoming families to Old Orchard Beach for over a decade. Four units in the same building means I can host couples, big families, and reunions of up to sixteen — all on the same quiet street, all five minutes' walk from seven miles of sand.
owner.p2: When you message me, you're talking to me. I usually reply within the hour, and I'm the one handing you the keypad code on arrival. No app middleman, no support ticket queue.
owner.p3: If something's not right during your stay, I want to hear about it — and I want to fix it.

reviews.empty: Reviews from our first season on this site are coming soon. In the meantime, you can read our reviews from over a decade of guests on Airbnb.
